INSERT INTO responses (id,invitation_id,event_id,status,guest_count,message,updated_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(invitation_id,event_id) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status,guest_count=excluded.guest_count,message=excluded.message,updated_at=excluded.updated_at

UPDATE invitations SET reception_table=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND reception_table=? AND (?='' OR seats+(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(other.seats),0) FROM invitations other WHERE other.id<>? AND other.active=1 AND other.reception_table=?)<=?)
